title: Stalk of internal Hom for a finitely presented module
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space, let $\mathcal F$ be a finitely presented $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation], let $\mathcal G$ be an $\mathcal O_X$-module, and let $x\in X$. For the internal sheaf Hom $\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal F,\mathcal G)$ [def-pur-sheaf-hom], the canonical map $\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal F,\mathcal G)_x\to\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_{X,x}}(\mathcal F_x,\mathcal G_x)$, sending a germ of a local morphism to its induced stalk map, is an isomorphism.

source.place: Modules, Lemma Tag 01CP (lemma-stalk-internal-hom), lines 3619-3678: finitely presented case via a finite free presentation and exactness of internal Hom

proof.text: Use the canonical linear evaluation map with its germ formula, proved without finiteness hypotheses.
Choose local presentation and finite-coordinate stalk kernel data U,m,n,s,a,b,beta. In particular b is surjective and beta is injective with range equal to the relation kernel.

Let epsilon send a stalk-linear map to its values on b(e_i), using piRing composed with precomposition by b. It is injective because b is surjective. On a representative local morphism over W, restrict the generator s_i to U intersect W; the germ formula and the formula for beta give epsilon(c(h))=beta(h). Therefore c is injective. For any chi, the relation map kills epsilon(chi), since b composed with a is zero. The range equality for beta supplies h with beta(h)=epsilon(chi); injectivity of epsilon then gives c(h)=chi. Apply LinearEquiv.ofBijective and keep the proved germ formula.

lean.statement: theorem exists_stalk_internalHom_linearEquiv_of_finitePresentation (X : RingedSpace.{u}) (F G : SheafOfModules.{u} ((sheafCompose (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj X.sheaf)) [SheafOfModules.IsFinitePresentation.{u} F] (x : X) : ∃ e : (moduleStalkFunctor X x).obj (F.homObj G) ≃ₗ[ X.presheaf.stalk x] ((moduleStalkFunctor X x).obj F →ₗ[X.presheaf.stalk x] (moduleStalkFunctor X x).obj G), ∀ (U : Opens X) (hxU : x ∈ U) (φ : (SheafOfModules.homObj F G).val.obj (op U)) (V : Opens X) (i : V ⟶ U) (hxV : x ∈ V) (s : F.val.obj (op V)), e (TopCat.Presheaf.germ (SheafOfModules.homObj F G).val.presheaf U x hxU φ) (TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf V x hxV s) = TopCat.Presheaf.germ G.val.presheaf V x hxV ((φ.app (op (Over.mk i))) s)
